# VERDICTS (generated by src/verdicts.py from the saved tables; rules in the docstring and in PREREG.md section 5 and D2)

Every pre-specified analysis is listed once with a mechanical verdict. 'unfavourable' = significant in the direction opposite to the row's own claim. Holm correction is applied within each family (F1..F6) as pre-listed; rows marked exploratory use unadjusted p-values and are not tests of record.
